title: Article: Remote work survey
passage:
MORE COMPANIES ADOPT HYBRID WORK

A new survey by the Business Research Institute has found that 64 percent of companies with more than 100 employees now allow staff to work from home at least two days a week. This is up from just 22 percent five years ago.

Most companies said that hybrid work has helped them attract and keep talented employees. However, 40 percent reported difficulties in maintaining team communication, especially for new employees who have fewer chances to learn from experienced colleagues.

To address this, many firms are now requiring employees to come to the office on the same days each week. "The office is becoming a place for collaboration rather than individual work," said researcher Dr. Paul Hansen.

The survey also found that companies are reducing their office space. Nearly one-third plan to move to smaller offices within the next three years.
translation:
ハイブリッド勤務を導入する企業が増加

ビジネス研究所の調査によると、従業員100人超の企業の64%が、少なくとも週2日の在宅勤務を認めている。5年前のわずか22%から増えた。

ほとんどの企業は、ハイブリッド勤務が優秀な人材の確保と定着に役立っていると答えた。しかし40%はチーム内の意思疎通の維持が難しいと報告した。特に、経験豊富な同僚から学ぶ機会の少ない新入社員にとって難しいという。

これに対応するため、多くの企業が毎週同じ曜日の出社を求めるようになっている。「オフィスは個人作業より共同作業の場になりつつある」と研究者のポール・ハンセン博士は述べた。

企業がオフィス面積を縮小していることもわかった。3分の1近くが今後3年以内により小さいオフィスに移る予定だ。

questions.question: What did the survey find?
choices: Most employees prefer to work in the office.
Small companies do not allow remote work.
Hybrid work has become much more common.
questions.explanation: 週2日以上の在宅勤務を認める企業が5年前の22%から64%に増えたとある。

questions.question: According to the article, who is especially affected by communication problems?
questions.explanation: 経験豊富な同僚から学ぶ機会の少ない新入社員にとって特に難しいとある。

questions.question: What are many companies doing to improve communication?
choices: Having staff come to the office on the same days
questions.explanation: 毎週同じ曜日の出社を求めているとある。

questions.question: What is suggested about office space?
choices: Many companies need less of it.
It is mainly used for individual work.
Most companies plan to expand it.
questions.explanation: 企業がオフィス面積を縮小し、3分の1近くが小さいオフィスに移る予定とある。

title: Email: Hotel booking confirmation
passage:
From: Reservations, Ocean Breeze Resort
To: Mr. Ahmed Khan
Subject: Booking confirmation #OB-5521

Dear Mr. Khan,

We are pleased to confirm your reservation:

Check-in: Friday, August 9 (from 3:00 P.M.)
Check-out: Monday, August 12 (by 11:00 A.M.)
Room: Deluxe Ocean View, two adults
Rate: $210 per night, breakfast included

As requested, we have arranged an airport pickup for your arrival at 1:30 P.M. Our driver will be waiting in the arrivals hall holding a sign with your name.

Please note that the resort's spa will be closed for maintenance on August 10. We apologize for any inconvenience.

Cancellations made more than 48 hours before check-in are free of charge.
translation:
カーン様

ご予約を以下のとおり確認いたしました。
チェックイン:8月9日(金)午後3時から/チェックアウト:8月12日(月)午前11時まで/客室:デラックス・オーシャンビュー、大人2名/料金:1泊210ドル(朝食付き)

チェックインの48時間前までのキャンセルは無料です。

title: Notice: Charity run
passage:
5K Charity Run for Children's Hospital
Saturday, June 8 | Start: 8:00 A.M. | Lakeside Park

Join us for a fun morning of running or walking to raise money for the City Children's Hospital! This year, we hope to raise $50,000 to buy new equipment for the hospital's emergency department.

Registration: $25 for adults, $10 for children under 12. All participants will receive a T-shirt and a medal. Register online by May 31 to receive a free water bottle.

The top three fundraisers will win prizes, including a weekend stay at a local hotel.

The event will go ahead in light rain. In case of severe weather, it will be postponed to June 15.
translation:
小児病院のための5キロチャリティーラン
6月8日(土)午前8時スタート/レイクサイド公園

市立小児病院への募金のため、ランニングやウォーキングに参加しませんか!今年は救急部門の新しい機器購入のため5万ドルを目指します。

参加費:大人25ドル、12歳未満10ドル。全員に T シャツとメダルを贈ります。5月31日までにオンライン登録すると水筒を無料で差し上げます。

募金額の上位3名には、地元ホテルの週末宿泊などの賞品があります。

小雨決行。荒天の場合は6月15日に延期します。

questions.question: What will the money raised be used for?
questions.explanation: 救急部門の新しい機器を買うためとある。

questions.question: What will participants who register by May 31 receive?

questions.question: What will happen if there is severe weather on June 8?

title: Letter: Warranty claim
passage:
Dear Customer Service Department,

I am writing about the KitchenPro blender (model KP-300) that I purchased from your online store on February 3. After using it only a few times, the motor stopped working completely.

According to the product information, the blender comes with a two-year warranty. I would therefore like to request either a repair or a replacement. I have attached a copy of my receipt and a photo of the product's serial number.

I would prefer a replacement, as I use the blender every day and would not like to wait several weeks for a repair. If a replacement is not possible, please let me know how long a repair would take.

Sincerely,
Grace Miller
translation:
カスタマーサービス部 御中

2月3日に御社のオンラインストアで購入したキッチンプロのブレンダー(KP-300型)についてご連絡します。数回使っただけでモーターがまったく動かなくなりました。

製品情報では2年保証が付いているとのことなので、修理か交換をお願いします。領収書のコピーとシリアル番号の写真を添付します。

毎日使っているので、修理を何週間も待ちたくなく、交換を希望します。交換が難しい場合は修理にかかる期間をお知らせください。

グレース・ミラー

questions.question: Why did Ms. Miller write the letter?
choices: To complain about a late delivery
questions.explanation: ブレンダーのモーターが動かなくなったことを報告し、修理か交換を求めている。

questions.question: What has Ms. Miller included with the letter?
questions.explanation: 領収書のコピー(購入の証明)を添付したとある。

questions.question: Why does Ms. Miller prefer a replacement?
choices: The warranty does not cover repairs.
questions.explanation: 毎日使っていて修理を待ちたくないとある。

title: Information: Factory tour
passage:
Sweet Valley Chocolate Factory Tours

Discover how our famous chocolates are made! Our 60-minute guided tour takes you through the entire chocolate-making process, from cocoa beans to finished bars.

Tour times: Tuesday–Saturday, 10:00 A.M., 1:00 P.M., and 3:00 P.M.
Tickets: Adults $15, Children (5–12) $8, Children under 5 free

Every tour ends with a tasting session. Visitors can also make their own chocolate bar in our workshop for an additional $10 (reservation required).

For safety reasons, visitors must wear the hairnets and shoe covers provided. Photography is not permitted in the production area.

Groups of 15 or more receive a 10 percent discount.
translation:
スウィートバレー・チョコレート工場見学

60分のガイドツアーで、カカオ豆から板チョコができるまでの全工程をご案内します。

ツアー時間:火〜土、午前10時・午後1時・午後3時/料金:大人15ドル、子ども(5〜12歳)8ドル、5歳未満無料

各ツアーの最後に試食会があります。追加10ドルで工房で自分の板チョコを作ることもできます(要予約)。

安全のため、用意したヘアネットと靴カバーを着用してください。製造エリアでの撮影は禁止です。

15人以上の団体は10%割引です。

questions.question: What is included in every tour?
questions.explanation: Every tour ends with a tasting session とある。板チョコ作りは追加料金。

questions.question: What are visitors required to do?
questions.explanation: ヘアネットと靴カバーの着用が必要とある。

questions.question: Who can receive a discount?
questions.explanation: 15人以上の団体は10%割引。

title: Email: New team member
passage:
From: Laura Bennett, Marketing Director
To: Marketing Team
Subject: Welcome Jason Lee

Hi team,

I'm pleased to announce that Jason Lee will be joining our department as Digital Marketing Specialist on Monday, October 7.

Jason has six years of experience in online advertising. Before joining us, he worked at a technology start-up, where he helped increase online sales by 80 percent in two years.

Jason will be responsible for managing our social media accounts and online advertising campaigns. Emily has kindly agreed to show him around during his first week.

We will have a welcome lunch for Jason on Wednesday, October 9, at noon. Please let me know by Monday if you have any dietary requirements.

Best,
Laura
translation:
チームの皆さん

10月7日(月)から、ジェイソン・リーさんがデジタルマーケティング担当として加わります。

ジェイソンさんはオンライン広告で6年の経験があり、前職のスタートアップでは2年でオンライン売上を80%伸ばすことに貢献しました。

ジェイソンさんにはソーシャルメディアのアカウントとオンライン広告の管理を担当してもらいます。最初の1週間はエミリーさんが案内役を引き受けてくれました。

10月9日(水)正午に歓迎ランチを開きます。食事の制限がある方は月曜日までに知らせてください。

ローラ

questions.explanation: 新しい社員の加入を知らせている。

questions.question: What is mentioned about Mr. Lee's previous job?
choices: He managed a team of six people.
He worked in the same department.
He helped increase a company's online sales.
questions.explanation: 前職でオンライン売上を80%伸ばすことに貢献したとある。

questions.question: What will Emily do?
choices: Help Mr. Lee during his first week
questions.explanation: 最初の1週間、エミリーさんが案内するとある。ランチを企画しているのはローラ。

title: Advertisement: Moving company
passage:

title: Memo: Budget preparation
passage:
MEMO
To: Department Heads
From: Michael Chen, Finance Director
Date: November 4
Re: Next year's budget

Please submit your department's budget proposal by November 20 using the attached template.

This year, all departments are asked to reduce their spending on travel by 15 percent. Wherever possible, meetings with clients and partners should be held online.

If your department plans any purchases of over $10,000, such as new equipment or software, please include a short explanation of why it is needed and how it will benefit the company.

I will meet with each department head individually during the first week of December to discuss your proposal. My assistant will contact you to arrange a time.
translation:
社内連絡
宛先:各部門長/差出人:財務部長 マイケル・チェン/日付:11月4日/件名:来年度予算

添付のテンプレートを使い、11月20日までに部門の予算案を提出してください。

今年は全部門に出張費を15%削減するようお願いします。可能な限り、顧客や取引先との打ち合わせはオンラインで行ってください。

設備やソフトなど1万ドルを超える購入を予定している場合は、必要な理由と会社への利点を簡単に説明してください。

12月第1週に各部門長と個別に面談します。日程はアシスタントから連絡します。

questions.question: What are department heads asked to do by November 20?
questions.explanation: 11月20日までに予算案を提出するよう求めている。

questions.question: What change is requested for next year?
questions.explanation: 出張費の15%削減を求めている。

questions.question: What must be included for large purchases?
questions.explanation: 必要な理由と利点の説明を求めている。

title: Review: Restaurant
passage:
Dinner at Saffron House — ★★★★☆
By Olivia Grant, Food Critic

Saffron House, which opened last month on Elm Street, offers modern Indian cuisine in a stylish setting. The chef, Ravi Kapoor, previously worked at several well-known restaurants in London.

The highlight of my meal was the lamb curry, which was rich and full of flavor. The vegetable dishes were also excellent. Desserts, however, were less impressive; the mango cake was rather dry.

Service was friendly, although the restaurant was very busy and our food took a while to arrive. Prices are slightly higher than at other Indian restaurants in the area, but the quality justifies the cost.

Reservations are strongly recommended, especially on weekends.
translation:
サフラン・ハウスでの夕食 — ★★★★☆ 料理評論家 オリビア・グラント

先月エルム通りに開店したサフラン・ハウスでは、おしゃれな雰囲気で現代的なインド料理が楽しめる。シェフのラヴィ・カプールは以前ロンドンの有名店で働いていた。

一番良かったのはコク深く風味豊かなラムカレー。野菜料理も素晴らしかった。ただデザートはそれほどではなく、マンゴーケーキはぱさついていた。

サービスは親切だったが、店が混んでいて料理が出るまで時間がかかった。価格は近隣の店より少し高いが、質を考えれば妥当だ。

特に週末は予約を強く勧める。

questions.question: What is indicated about the chef?
choices: He opened the restaurant ten years ago.
questions.explanation: 以前ロンドンの有名店で働いていたとある。

questions.question: What did the critic NOT like?
questions.explanation: マンゴーケーキがぱさついていたとある。

questions.question: What does the critic say about the prices?
choices: They are reasonable for the quality.
They are the lowest in the area.
They are too high for the portions.
questions.explanation: 少し高いが質を考えれば妥当(justifies the cost)とある。

title: Notice: Office supplies ordering
passage:
NEW PROCEDURE FOR ORDERING OFFICE SUPPLIES

Starting April 1, all requests for office supplies must be submitted through the online ordering system on the company intranet. Paper request forms will no longer be accepted.

Orders submitted by noon on Tuesday will be delivered to your department on Thursday of the same week. Orders submitted after this time will be delivered the following week.

Each department has a monthly supply budget. Orders that exceed the budget must be approved by your department manager.

For items not listed in the online catalog, please contact the Purchasing Department at extension 3300.
translation:
事務用品の新しい注文方法

4月1日から、事務用品の請求はすべて社内イントラネットのオンライン注文システムで行います。紙の請求書は受け付けません。

火曜日正午までの注文は同じ週の木曜日に各部署へ届きます。それ以降の注文は翌週の配達です。

各部署には毎月の予算があります。予算を超える注文には部門長の承認が必要です。

カタログにない品は購買部(内線3300)に連絡してください。

questions.question: What is changing on April 1?
choices: The location of the Purchasing Department
questions.explanation: 請求をすべてオンラインで行うように変わる。

questions.question: If an order is submitted on Wednesday, when will it most likely arrive?
choices: On Thursday of the same week
questions.explanation: 火曜正午以降の注文は翌週の配達になる。

questions.question: What is required for orders that exceed the budget?
choices: A call to the Purchasing Department
questions.explanation: 予算超過の注文には部門長の承認が必要。
